video.label: ABCA / Bryson LeBlanc - Swinging vs. Hitting

extraction.verifiedTitle: Missouri Tigers Hitting Philosophy - ABCA Barnstormers
extraction.overallNotes: Whiteboard coaching lecture delivered at Taylor Stadium on process-driven approach over outcome bias, highlighting pitch-by-pitch focus and timing for the fastball.

claims.claimText: Hitters should anchor their approach on being consistently on time for the pitcher's best fastball.
claims.sourceProposition: Our core philosophy is to be on time for his best fastball; when hitters truly believe they are on time for the best fastball, it opens up their entire offensive execution.
claims.observableEvidence: Hitter showing early tempo and pitch-release readiness synchronized with fastball velocity.
claims.appliesWhen: Standard plate appearances across all counts.
claims.doesNotApplyWhen: Situational at-bats where sitting on a specific offspeed pitch is explicitly called.
claims.qualityNotes: Focuses on pitch timing anchor point and mental readiness.
claims.coachingCue: Be on time for his best fastball
claims.levelScopeNote: Applicable to all levels from youth to college.

claims.claimText: Hitters should measure success by winning individual pitches rather than tracking box-score outcome results.
claims.sourceProposition: To alleviate outcome pressure, hitters must reverse-engineer success from outcome results back to winning individual pitches.
claims.observableEvidence: Quality at-bat metrics, pitch selectivity, and consistent approach unaffected by single-at-bat results.
claims.appliesWhen: All game at-bats and practice routines.
claims.qualityNotes: Process-driven mental framework aimed at reducing outcome anxiety.
claims.levelScopeNote: Applicable across all levels of play.

weakOrRejectedNotes: No mechanical swing claims or physical drill demonstrations were included in this presentation.
